=== edge-procedure-recursion
--- main

C : $n

=== edge-mutual-recursion
--- main
!function $even($n)
!if $n == 0
!return 1
!endif
!return $odd($n - 1)
!endfunction
!function $odd($n)
!if $n == 0
!return 0
!endif
!return $even($n - 1)
!endfunction
A : $even(10) $odd(7)
=== edge-local-shadow-in-recursion
--- main

!local $x = $n
!if $n > 0
!$y = $f($n - 1)
!endif
!return $x
!endfunction
A : $f(3)
